{{Quote|Attention BDY crew skiffs: Turn away ''now''. This will be your only warning.''"<br />"''Turn away or ''what'', Jedi Solo?|Jaina Solo and a Sith commander|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
In [[44 ABY]], a '''skirmish''' took place near [[Ashteri's Cloud/Legends|Ashteri's Cloud]]. The ''[[Rockhound]]'', carrying [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], was [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|sabotaged]] by [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Solo flew out in her [[StealthX]] and confronted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]; however, when she used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|guide]] her [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bombs]], the Sith were able to track her and fire on her, causing her to take heavy damage. She still managed to destroy the [[BDY crew skiff|skiffs]] they sent after her while Calrissian found and destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had sabotaged the ''Rockhound'', and they escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Time to go. You handle the mouse, and I'll take care of&hellip;whoever sent it.|Jaina Solo, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
Following the completion of their [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to assist [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in his [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|dealings]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and in confronting [[Abeloth]] in [[44 ABY]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] left [[Abeloth's planet]] in Calrissian's [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug]], the ''[[Rockhound]]'', to report to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had managed to get an [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|mouse droid]] on board, programmed to sabotage the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. As such, the ''Rockhound'' came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] far off-course, near Ashteri's Cloud.<ref name="Vortex" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|I don't need shields to take down a bunch of pirates.''"<br />"''EXPERIENCE WOULD SUGGEST OTHERWISE.|Jaina Solo and Rowdy|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
After discovering the presence of the sabotage [[Droid/Legends|droid]], Solo and Calrissian deduced that they were under attack by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Solo flew out in her [[StealthX]] to confront the pirates, finding that their forces consisted of an [[S18 light freighter]] and [[BDY crew skiff]]s. She hailed them and warned them to turn away immediately, and when they neglected to comply, Solo fired a [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bomb]] at one of the [[Shuttle/Legends|skiffs]]. The bomb destroyed the crew cabin, but her use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|direct]] the bomb informed the attackers where she was, and they opened fire on her craft.<ref name="Vortex" />

Solo's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] overloaded, and her [[R9-series astromech droid]], [[Rowdy]], reported that the signal had come from the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. As soon as she launched the next shadow bomb and began to guide it through the Force, however, the Sith found her again and opened fire on her once more, causing her to lose her grasp on the shadow bomb. Rowdy reported that the StealthX's maneuverability was limited and that their shields had not yet come back online, and Solo decided to launch the next shadow bomb. Again they opened fire on her, but she remained in control of the bomb, and at least twenty-four of the attackers died in the resulting explosion. Solo finally realized that the pirates were tracking her by her use of the Force<ref name="Vortex" />

Still, Solo ordered decided to launch her final shadow bomb. As the targeted skiff rolled to try and bring its weapons to bear, Solo flew her StealthX right under the ''Rockhound''{{'s}} belly, staying in her target's efflux trail. The bomb hit its target, and Solo contacted Calrissian, who reported that he had found and destroyed the sabotage droid aboard the ''Rockhound''. Solo requested that he have his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[RN8|Ornate]], begin plotting a hyperspace jump course immediately, and to jump as soon as it was ready. She managed to land her StealthX in the ''Rockhound''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] before the vessel jumped to safety.<ref name="Vortex" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|There are Sith ''everywhere''. And they're building a war fleet!|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
Solo and Calrissian contacted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]], who had been investigating pirate activities, and drew up a map of ships that had been pirated in similar situations to theirs&mdash;a port call followed by the disappearance of the ship in question, with no survivors, bodies found, or wreckage. They found hundreds of such situations, and when they reported to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] on Coruscant, the Jedi realized that the Lost Tribe of Sith was preparing a war fleet.<ref name="Vortex" />
